$comment: No dedicated schema exists for this file (schema-gap, noted in docs/known-limitations.md). Shape follows CONVENTIONS 4.3 (win tiers), 9.2 (presentation modes never alter outcomes) and 9.5 (LDW never celebrated above small). All durations are presentation-only; the committed outcome manifest is authoritative.

winTiers.$comment: Thresholds are win/totalBet per CONVENTIONS 4.3. max is reached only when maximumWinXBet (10000x) is hit.

ldwRule.$comment: CONVENTIONS 9.5: a return <= stake is never celebrated above small tier; jurisdiction flag ldwCelebrationSuppressed routes it to the neutral result preset.

anticipation.$comment: Presentation-only per CONVENTIONS 9.5: driven strictly by the committed outcome, never by weighted near-miss reel adjacency.

equivalenceInvariant: Same outcome manifest => identical final balance and totalWinMinor in normal, quick, turbo, skipped, autoplay, and recovered presentations (CONVENTIONS 9.2). A real run ships this as an automated client test; this example records it as the binding contract.
